geometry_and_method: 2-D circular drop, quadtree, Stokes flow, built-in VOF and tension.h
reported_metrics: max velocity times sqrt(diameter), shape error norms, maximum curvature error
comparison_limit: Qualitative implementation and convergence reference only; not quantitatively comparable to the current 3-D adaptive R=1 sphere tests, which use rho=mu=sigma=1 and report Ca=mu*U/sigma.
provenance_note: Pinned third-party 2019 mirror snapshot. Official basilisk.fr source endpoint returned HTTP 403 in this environment; no official release tag or signature was verified.
